description: A Viam navigation stack wrapping the ROS2 Nav2 and slam_toolbox packages for mapping, localization, and obstacle-aware navigation on any Viam base.

models.short_description: SLAM service wrapping slam_toolbox for mapping and localization on a Viam base.
Motion MoveOnMap via builtin navigator (or Nav2), plus locations/zones/go-to DoCommand on a Viam base.
Motion MoveOnMap from any rdk:service:slam; builtin path is ROS-free (get_grid/GetPosition + base).
Renders the nav service's costmap, active plans, robot pose and goal as a camera image.
